## Comment Rule
- WRITE EVERY NEW COMMENT IN ALL UPPERCASE LETTERS.
- WHEN MODIFYING AN EXISTING COMMENT, CONVERT THE ENTIRE MODIFIED COMMENT TO ALL UPPERCASE LETTERS.
- APPLY THIS RULE TO COMMENTS IN EVERY FILE TYPE, INCLUDING INLINE, BLOCK, DOC, MARKDOWN, AND CONFIGURATION COMMENTS.
- DO NOT CHANGE UNTOUCHED COMMENTS ONLY TO ENFORCE THIS RULE.
- DO NOT UPPERCASE STRING LITERALS, USER-FACING TEXT, IDENTIFIERS, OR DOCUMENTATION BODY TEXT UNLESS IT IS A COMMENT.
